base: Use case: stylized-concept, production pixel-art sprite animation sheet. Reference image is the APPROVED design: male Mac on left, female Elias on right. Match exactly the chosen character's face, costume, normal healthy athletic proportions, pixel detailing and colors. Fresh coherent drawings, never horizontally squeezed. Actual crisp square-pixel clusters, clean stepped edges, no blur, no painted gradients. This is an animation asset for a right-facing side-scrolling game. ALL frames face RIGHT with the SAME fixed three-quarter side camera, head facing right, no turns and no mirrored character. Completely TRANSPARENT background with real alpha, not black or white and no checker pattern. No ground, no cast shadows, no text, no numbers, no frames or grid lines. Keep every frame wholly inside its evenly spaced cell with transparent gutters. Consistent pixel scale and fixed head size across all cells.
actions:
BODY ACTIONS sheet: exactly SIX full-body sprites in THREE columns and TWO rows on a landscape 3:2 canvas. Remove BOTH ARMS AND HANDS completely at the shoulder joint: these are body-only layers, with head, neck, torso, hips and legs still a single connected shape. No weapons. Match the approved reference character exactly.
Top row from left: (0) relaxed upright idle, feet moderately apart, slight knee relaxation, natural 3/4-right view; (1) SAME idle frame with only a tiny inhalation/chest rise and a few pixels of cloth settling; (2) jump preparation / landing, knees visibly bent, hips down, torso forward a little.
Bottom row from left: (3) rising jump, both knees lifted with one boot slightly forward and one back; (4) apex, tucked knees and natural forward-ready torso; (5) falling, legs extending downward ready to land.
Keep identical costume, face, head size, body mass and arm socket shape in every frame. Do NOT bake fake vertical travel into row1 idle foot positions. White panels on the female's split coat remain readable and follow the motion. For male preserve beanie/silver hair/brown jacket/white shirt/black trousers/black boots. For female preserve gold-trim black beret/blonde bob/black-red-gold military uniform/white inner long skirt panels/black boots. Transparent image, with NO shadows, NO captions and generous clear gutters.
arms:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production pixel sprite ARM LAYER for the character in reference image2. Image1 is the approved costume concept, image2 is the body layer these arms will be attached to. Draw ONLY detached WHOLE PAIRS OF ARMS, from shoulders through elbows to hands. NO head, NO torso, NO hips, NO legs, NO gun. Normal adult anatomy, slender but healthy, same upper-arm and forearm lengths; sleeves not swollen. Pixel art crisp stepped contours, flat pixel clusters, no painterly blur. 
A transparent portrait sheet in exactly THREE COLUMNS and FOUR ROWS, TWELVE evenly spaced cells, generous 25px empty gutters. Every cell is ONE joined pair of complete arms. Front shoulder located on left of cell; front sleeve overlaps the shoulder stump on the body. Far arm behind near arm. BOTH hands make a plausible two-handed grip (but leave the weapons out; code adds them).
Row1 left to right: long gun aiming vertically UP90 (bent elbows, trigger hand near chin, support hand directly above); long gun UP45 (support hand farther up-right than trigger hand); long gun horizontalRIGHT (trigger hand in front of chest, support hand farther right).
Row2 left to right: long gun DOWN45 (support hand farther down-right); long gun straightDOWN90 (support hand below trigger hand); long gun carried horizontally at belly (elbows relaxed, hands level).
Row3 left to right: pistol UP90 (near trigger hand raised beside face, other hand stabilizes wrist); pistol UP45 (both hands meet on diagonal); pistol horizontalRIGHT (near arm extended and other hand wraps it).
Row4 left to right: pistol DOWN45 (joined hands diagonal down-right); pistol DOWN90 (joined hands below); pistol uprightREADY (elbows bent, hands together in front of face, gun would point UP).
Each entire arm pair is self-contained in its cell, NO sleeve fragments or extra hands, NO seam gaps at elbows. All12 pairs have identical scale, clothing, lighting. Use reference2 torso scale: front shoulder to elbow about75px and elbow to fingers80px at a full-character height460px, arm diameter about30px. Wrist narrower than upper arm. This is a rig overlay, therefore no invisible person's body or shoulder sockets between the arms. Background truly alpha transparent. NO captions, NO drawn frames, NO shadows.
walkFix:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit ONLY THE LOWER BODY walking poses in this 8-sprite 4columns x2rows sheet. Preserve every head, face, torso, costume color, render style, grid placement, and transparency. Keep armless connected body sprites. CURRENT ERROR: all8 sprites have the same leg extended forward, which reads as limping. Need a genuine alternating8-frame walk. Character always facesRIGHT.
Near leg is the leg attached to the left/near hip beneath near shoulder, rendered on TOP of the other leg at overlap in ALL frames, whether it is stepping forward OR backward. Far leg is slightly darker and ALWAYS behind. Never swap leg z-order.
Number frames row-major0..7. Redraw legs/boots/cloth according to these exact positions:
0 NEAR leg extends forwardRIGHT heel contacting floor; FAR leg extends backwardLEFT toe onfloor.
1 near leg now nearly vertical supporting weight; far leg lifts behind with bentknee.
2 PASSING: near leg vertical and planted. Far knee SWINGS FORWARD RIGHT of supporting knee, lifted far boot passes behind planted shin, both feet close together.
3 near leg trails BACK LEFT pushing off, far knee reaches FORWARD RIGHT with far boot extended but not landed.
4 OPPOSITE CONTACT: near leg fully extended BACK LEFT on toe; FAR leg fully extended FORWARD RIGHT heel contacting floor. The near thigh goes diagonally DOWN-LEFT over the far thigh, NOT diagonally right. This pose MUST LOOK DIFFERENT from frame0.
5 far leg nearly vertical supporting weight; near knee bends with boot lifting behind.
6 OPPOSITE PASSING: far leg planted vertical; near knee swings forwardRIGHT, lifted near boot crosses visibly IN FRONT of planted far shin. Bothfeetclosetogether.
7 near leg reaches FORWARD RIGHT heel extended ready to land; far leg trails BACK LEFT pushing off.
Normal walking, not running: at least one boot touches ground eachframe, no jump. No change in leg length. Coattails followlegmotion, but reveal enough boots and knee contours to read crossing. Foot-contact baseline consistent within eachrow. No duplicate poses. Preserve transparent background, no floor/shadows/text, spritegrid4x2.
